message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on the nearest weekday, giving you a 3‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Notes |
|---------|-----------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** (Sunday 1 → Monday 2 observed) | 3‑day weekend (Sunday‑Monday‑Tuesday) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Monday 20) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Monday) |
| **Good Friday** | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Friday 7) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Sunday) |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 20 – May 22** (Monday 22) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Monday) |
| **Canada Day** | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Saturday 1 → Monday 3 observed) | 3‑day weekend (Saturday‑Monday) |
| **Labour Day** | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Monday 4) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Monday) |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Monday 9) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Monday) |
| **Remembrance Day** | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Saturday 11 → Monday 13 observed) | 3‑day weekend (Saturday‑Monday) |
| **Christmas Day** | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Monday 25) | 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Monday) |

### Quick Summary
- **January**: New Year’s (Jan 1‑3)  
- **February**: Family Day (Feb 18‑20)  
- **April**: Good Friday (Apr 7‑9)  
- **May**: Victoria Day (May 20‑22)  
- **July**: Canada Day (Jul 1‑3)  
- **September**: Labour Day (Sep 2‑4)  
- **October**: Thanksgiving (Oct 7‑9)  
- **November**: Remembrance Day (Nov 11‑13)  
- **December**: Christmas (Dec 23‑25)

> **Note:** Some provinces have additional holidays that may create extra long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the “Heritage Day” in Ontario). The table above lists the nationwide statutory holidays that generate long weekends in 2023. If you need province‑specific details, let me know!
